name: Keycloak Admin REST API
tagline: Open-source IdP admin API for realms, users, clients, and SSO
description: Keycloak's Admin REST API lets operators and apps manage realms, users, groups, clients, roles, sessions, and identity providers over HTTP. It is self-hosted or cloud-deployed with the Keycloak server; there is no single public SaaS base URL. Authentication uses a realm admin access token (password or client credentials).

auth.details: Bearer access token from the master (or admin) realm token endpoint, typically via password grant for a realm-management admin user or client_credentials for a confidential client with realm-management roles. Send Authorization: Bearer <token> on Admin REST calls.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Fully free and open source (Apache 2.0); no request quotas from the project. Hosting and cloud vendor costs apply separately.
pricing.paid_plans: No official paid API tiers from the Keycloak project; commercial support available via Red Hat build of Keycloak and third-party hosts.

rate_limits: not published (self-hosted; operators configure their own limits)
use_cases: list or search users in a realm
create or update a realm user and set credentials
assign realm or client roles to a user
list active user sessions and revoke them
export or inspect realm configuration for backup/automation
